intent: One agent at work: a live clock and running cost lead; finished steps sit in a time strip you can open. Waiting shows the exact action as an ApprovalCard.
useWhen: watch one agent run in detail
inspect a step's duration, tokens and cost
approve the agent's next action in place
pause, resume, cancel or retry a run
doNotUseWhen: many agents at a glance — RunningNow
a step-by-step log with labels — AgentTrail

status.note: idle shows Empty with Start run.

steps.note: { id, tool, status: "done" | "running" | "waiting" | "failed", icon?, target?, duration?, tokens?, cost?, started?, weight? }[]. Every step in the strip has the same width; weight is ignored (deprecated).

onSelectStep.note: (id | null) => void. Strip steps become toggle buttons; the detail panel has Close.

pendingAction.note: Waiting: { title, description?, risk?, action } rendered as a kit ApprovalCard.

collapsed.note: One row with clock, cost and the tools used.

onOpenTrail.note: Done: Open trail. Failed: Open failed step.

requirements: the clock is role=timer with aria-live off
strip steps are toggle buttons (aria-pressed) named with tool, status and duration
the detail panel is a named region with a Close button
pending action is a kit ApprovalCard (Enter / Escape)
collapse is a button with aria-expanded
motion is transform and opacity only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local AgentMonitor, RunCard, or AgentStatusCard
Do not rebuild the approval UI; pass pendingAction
Only one solid primary: Approve, Resume or Start run, never two
snippet: <AgentMonitor name="Refactor billing service" meta="claude-code · acme-demo" status="running" headline="Editing src/billing/invoice.ts" headlineNote="step 6" elapsed="02:14" cost="$0.42" steps={steps} axis={["0:00", "1:00", "2:14"]} onSelectStep={setStepId} />
